Class PhaseController

java.lang.Object
mesos.client.ui.model.PhaseController
public final class PhaseController extends Object
Local-only state machine that derives a GuiPhase from the latest server snapshot. Panels subscribe via addListener(Runnable) and re-read this controller after each change to decide what to highlight, enable, or display.

Threading: update(SnapshotMessage) must be called on the EDT. Listeners are invoked synchronously on the calling thread (the EDT).

Transport-agnostic: the controller only consumes SnapshotMessage plus the local nickname, so it works identically over TCP or RMI.

    • getActivePlayerNickname

      public String getActivePlayerNickname()
      Returns the nickname of the player whose turn it currently is, or null during lobby, waiting, or end-game phases.

      The server does not expose an explicit "active player" field in the snapshot. We approximate it from the local GuiPhase: when it is this client's turn (GuiPhase.isMyTurn()), we return our own nickname so that PlayerPanel can highlight us with the * marker.

    • isTileClickable

      public boolean isTileClickable(String tileId)
      True when the local player can click the given tile to place their totem. Returns false outside PLACEMENT_MINE, or when the tile is already occupied.
